name: Fireball

header.Components: V, S, M (a ball of bat guano and sulfur)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

authored_intent: Point-origin 20-foot sphere DEX-half Fire; higher slots add 1d6; ignite unworn/uncarried flammable objects.

rules.text: A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion.
Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried start burning.
The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
